subject: Problems with GBIF data on Wallace

messages.author: d73691b565754184
messages.subject: Problems with GBIF data on Wallace
parts:
Some users are reporting problems with downloading occurrences from GBIF. To fix this problem, please update the rgbif package to the last version (3.3.0).

You can use the following code:
install.packages("rgbif") 

To check the rgbif version installed:
packageVersion("rgbif")

Best,
Gonzalo
